title: Jurassic Jungle
detail: Decorate with green leaves, vines, and a few plush dinosaurs for a playful, cost‑effective vibe.

title: Eggless T‑Rex Cake
detail: Bake an egg‑free cake in a T‑rex shape, using simple icing and a chocolate dinosaur topper.

title: Dinosaur‑shaped Cookies
detail: Bake or buy eggless cookies cut into dinosaur shapes to complement the theme.

title: Themed Storytime
detail: Read a short dinosaur tale or play a simple audio story about a T‑rex adventure.

title: DIY Dino Wall
detail: Create a large wall collage of printed dinosaur cutouts and stick them on a blank wall with tape.

title: Vintage Elegance
detail: Classic white and gold accents paired with vintage lanterns for a timeless touch.

title: Temple‑Inspired Archways
detail: Ornate archways made of wood and gold leaf, echoing South Indian temple gateways, set in pastel colors.

title: South Indian Feast
detail: An array of dosas, idlis, vadas, and a variety of spicy curries served in a buffet style with vegetarian and non‑vegetarian options.

title: DJ with Cultural Mix
detail: A DJ blending South Indian beats with international hits, ensuring a vibrant dance floor.

title: Pastel Palate
detail: A soft pastel palette with blush pinks, mint greens, and buttery creams for a gentle, romantic vibe.

title: Traditional Festive
detail: Bright red and orange color scheme with traditional motifs like mango leaves and marigold garlands.

title: DIY Rangoli Station
detail: Set up vibrant chalk and flower powder stations where guests can create their own rangoli designs.

title: Plant-based Snacks
detail: Include simple, budget-friendly plant-based snacks like roasted chickpeas and spiced popcorn.

title: Dance Workshop
detail: Host a short dance workshop teaching basic folk dance steps for all age groups.

title: Eco-friendly Banner
detail: Use hand-painted bamboo banners with community messages, blending tradition and sustainability.

title: Classic Ballroom
detail: Opulent white drapes, gold chandeliers, and mirrored décor for a timeless, regal atmosphere.

title: Royal Ivory Drapery
detail: Luxurious white curtains draped over arches and pillars, adorned with gold tassels for added glamour.

title: Signature Gold‑Dusted Desserts
detail: Assorted pastries and cakes dusted with edible gold flakes, served on white porcelain.

title: Live DJ with Golden Accents
detail: A DJ mixing contemporary music, with gold LED lighting and a white backdrop for a chic vibe.

title: Jain Vegetarian Feast
detail: A lavish spread of seasonal vegetables, dairy delicacies, and intricate pastries, all prepared to Jain dietary standards.

title: Vintage 60s Bollywood
detail: Old gramophone, sepia-toned tablecloths, and a mini photo booth with 1960s props.

title: DIY Neon Signs
detail: Create neon letters spelling celebratory words using colored LED strips.

title: Biryani & Raita
detail: Serve a single pot of aromatic biryani with a side of raita for a comforting main.

title: Movie Reel Screening
detail: Set up a screen or TV to show a favorite 60s Bollywood movie for a relaxed vibe.

title: Retro Bollywood
detail: Bright neon lighting, vintage movie posters and a jukebox playing classic Hindi hits.

title: Holiday Glow
detail: Gingerbread-inspired décor with warm amber lighting to evoke holiday cheer.

title: Warm Fabric Drapes
detail: Lightweight cotton or wool drapes in warm tones draped over the stage and seating for a cozy look.

title: Seasonal Street Food
detail: Taco and kebab stalls with hot sauces to keep the food budget-friendly and festive.

title: Carol Singing Ensemble
detail: Arrange a group of local singers to perform classic carols, ensuring the must‑have is met.

title: DIY Pinecone Accents
detail: Use pinecones and small wreaths made from twine and greenery to add rustic charm around the venue.
